content-atomizer.alt: Content atomizer: receive an article, draft three formats, review the drafts, then publish approved versions.
content-atomizer.caption: A review step separates generated drafts from public posts. Original workflow schematic for structured multi-channel publishing.

voice-production.alt: Narration workflow: prepare a script and authorized voice, generate a short sample, review pronunciation and delivery, then export approved audio.
voice-production.caption: Review a short sample before generating the complete narration. The diagram describes a workflow; it makes no latency or quality benchmark claim.

higgsfield-three-shot-stop-rule.alt: Three shots and one stop rule: arrival wide view, preparation contact view, decision close push, and concrete rejection conditions before rendering another clip.
higgsfield-three-shot-stop-rule.caption: The three-shot acceptance workflow and stop rule. Verify geometry and contact, and accept the face only when it still matches the reference.

higgsfield-camera-settings.alt: Higgsfield camera, lens, focal length and aperture selector in the earlier Cinema Studio interface.
higgsfield-camera-settings.caption: Archived official interface screenshot: the camera and lens selector from the earlier Cinema Studio guide. Current controls may differ; use this to understand the relationship between camera look, focal length and aperture.
higgsfield-camera-settings.rights: vendor documentation excerpt for attributed editorial commentary

higgsfield-studio-interface.alt: Earlier Higgsfield Cinema Studio workspace with preview, reference image and prompt controls.
higgsfield-studio-interface.caption: Archived official Cinema Studio 2.0 workspace. Locate the reference, prompt and preview before your first test; follow current documentation for exact button names.
higgsfield-studio-interface.rights: vendor documentation excerpt for attributed editorial commentary

elevenlabs-journal-audio-briefing.alt: Four-step founder journal to consent-based audio briefing pipeline: public journal note and character ceiling, voice-owner consent and allowlist check, idempotent ElevenLabs synthesis, and MP3 frame QA with provenance manifest.
elevenlabs-journal-audio-briefing.caption: Governed journal-to-audio briefing pipeline. Halt immediately if the note is private, voice-owner consent is missing, or synthesized MP3 bytes fail header and loudness inspection.

proof-project-three-routes.alt: One project, three routes: pick a problem from the role, build a small working answer, publish it with a short walkthrough, then use it for a job application, a paid pilot or a feedback loop.
proof-project-three-routes.caption: One project can serve a job application, a first paid pilot and a learning loop at the same time. Original schematic.

proof-toolkit-layers.alt: Your AI crew in three layers: prompts help you think, skills make your process consistent, MCP connects real tools such as GitHub, notes and deploy. You approve every send, merge and publish.
proof-toolkit-layers.caption: Prompts for thinking, a skill for the repeatable process, MCP for real tools. The human keeps the approval step. Original schematic.

wearable-capability-architecture.alt: Proposed architecture: device adapters negotiate capabilities before authenticated inference, scoped context and reviewed tools.
wearable-capability-architecture.caption: Proposed integration architecture. The device-adapter and shared-runtime components require integration; this article tests a separate mock backend.

wearable-governed-action.alt: Proposed workflow: capture consent, policy checks and inference produce a proposal; explicit approval precedes a local receipt.
wearable-governed-action.caption: Proposed action boundary. The starter saves a process-local note only; production tools require durable approval and scoped credentials.
